_comment: Cursor hooks template. Replace {{SCRIPT_PATH}} with the hook command. For a copied-source checkout use 'python3 .cursor/hooks/opentelemetry-hook/otel_hook.py' (the default set by setup.sh); use 'otel-hook' only for a pip-installed package. Copy to .cursor/hooks.json to enable.
_comment_merge: If you already have .cursor/hooks.json, merge the hooks section instead of overwriting it.
